name: Ui_DiveForm_PopPanesToHandler
summary: Unwinds the dive-form page stack with Ui_DiveForm_PopPane until the popped page matches the handler descriptor 0x0072C4C8, leaving the form on the matching page.
evidence: Body is a PopPane loop comparing each entry's id/flag pair against 0x0072C4C8; called by Ui_DiveForm_SelectNext/SelectPrev/OnAnimEnd and several input handlers.

name: Field_TalkBalloon_OpenMessage
signature: int Field_TalkBalloon_OpenMessage(TalkBalloon* self, int speaker, int style, int owner)
summary: Talk-balloon message start: optionally plays SE 9, then invokes Script_CallBookIdCommand on the event state (+0x6C) with the balloon's speaker and character bytes.
evidence: Calls Sound_PlaySeById(9) and Script_CallBookIdCommand with self->speakerId/characterKind; no callers to prove the exact variant, so kept moderate.

name: Field_TalkBalloon_OpenSimpleMessage
signature: int Field_TalkBalloon_OpenSimpleMessage(TalkBalloon* self, int speaker, int style, int owner)
summary: Simple talk-balloon variant: lazily allocates the shared 0x1EB0 text object, plays SE 9 and raises event command 0x14 through Event_OnTriggerCommand.
evidence: Companion of 0x003D9484; calls Event_OnTriggerCommand(eventState,0x14) and Sound_PlaySeById(9); callers are field scene object table init/update.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemList_SelectItem
signature: void maybe_Ui_ItemList_SelectItem(void* self, u32 list, char* names)
summary: Selection loop of an item list that writes the chosen index, refreshes category text and scroll, and formats the item name into a message argument.
evidence: Body heavily damaged (unaff_* registers, garbled index math); only callees Item_LookupRecord/Message_SetArg/Text_FormatMessageArg are trustworthy.

name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_SelectMemberGauge
summary: Entry point that constructs the select window then falls into the shared 31-member scan binding the selected entry to the HP gauge window.
evidence: First call is the window ctor 0x00325500 (also used by Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel); body merges into the member-gauge scan; no direct callers.

name: Model_ApplyCharacterParam
summary: Applies a character-display parameter to the model: resolves the party member, bails when the member's +0xDA bit 0x10 is set, resolves the portrait index and binds the resulting transform/resource.
evidence: Calls Party_ResolveAppearanceVariantIndex and 0x0035EB98(work,self->f_3C); callers Gfx_CreateEquipObjectForNode and Field_Actor_RefreshEquippedModel; several unreachable blocks removed.

name: Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromDescMesh
summary: Initializes a sprite actor mesh component from a descriptor: copies layer/colour/position fields, sets Euler rotation and builds the child descriptor.
evidence: Calls Gfx_Node_SetEulerRotation and Gfx_CreateMeshObjectByParams; caller is Field_SceneSpawnBlock_SpriteActorAligned.

name: maybe_Effect_QuadEmitter_SetupA
summary: A-variant setup of a sprite emitter: copies layer/colour/position/rotation from the definition, builds one type-2 sprite child descriptor, attaches it at f_278, stores the origin and loads effect pack 0x4B5.
evidence: Twin of 0x0040D620; calls Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChildC, Gfx_EffectPack_LoadById(0x4B5) and Gfx_Node_SetEulerRotation; caller Field_SceneSpawnBlock_EffectQuadEmitterA.

name: maybe_Effect_QuadEmitter_SetupB
summary: Second variant of the sprite-emitter setup: copies layer/scale/origin from the definition, builds a child sprite descriptor, attaches it and loads effect pack 0x4B5.
evidence: Same body as 0x0040D4F8 apart from variant flag/sub-id; only caller is the unnamed field spawn block; callees Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChildC and Gfx_EffectPack_LoadById fix the effect-emitter family but 'quad' is unproven.

name: maybe_Effect_SpriteEmitter_SetupE
summary: Configures a sprite-only effect emitter: copies position/layer from the definition, adds one billboard child sprite and initialises a sub-object with the definition's byte 4.
evidence: Only Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChildC is a confident callee and the sole caller is the unnamed field spawner block; the lettered variant and emitter class stay inferred.

name: Casino_Poker_RotateHandSlots
summary: Reorders the dealt poker hand: shuffles the two ten-slot halves, swaps a game-RNG-derived number of 2-byte slots between the halves and shuffles the first half again.
evidence: All nine callers are Casino_Poker_DealHand* variants and the three Casino_Poker_ShuffleU16 calls are named; the swap count is the lost RNG modulo result (extraout_r1), so the exact rule is unverified.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_RebuildSprite
summary: Rebuild path for a 2D object sprite: releases the old handle, builds the footprint rect and re-registers the sprite as a child.
evidence: Control flow is damaged (halt_baddata, software_interrupt(0x24), unaff_r4) and there are no callers; only Gfx_Sprite_BuildFootprintRect and Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild fix the sprite family.

name: maybe_Effect_ParticleEmitter_InitPoolD
summary: Allocates a 0xAC-byte effect object with vtable 0x75AFFC and a 64-entry two-word pool, falling back to the default block when allocation fails.
evidence: Same allocate-copy-or-default template as the other effect-node creators; vtable 0x75AFFC is a two-state sequence node, so the object is an effect sequence rather than necessarily a particle emitter.

name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_CreateSpriteWithArgs
summary: Creates a 200x120 sprite with a custom vertex format via Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh and stores the mesh on the object.
evidence: Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh and Gfx_Sprite_CreateInstance are confident callees, but the owning overlay-slot class is inferred and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_ProfileScreen_UpdateSelection
summary: State-machine step of a list window: activates the cursor row when no party name is loaded, otherwise selects controller state 4, 5 or 8 depending on pause and root mode, then runs the controller.
evidence: No callers; body only shows state ids 4/5/8 handed to the controller at f_11C and the Party_GetFirstNameLength test, so the class and role remain guesses.

name: maybe_Ui_ProfileScreen_ConfirmSelection
summary: Confirm step of the same window: when the root singleton is idle it resets the save-work transform and either activates the cursor row or advances the controller at f_11C to state 9.
evidence: No callers; shares the f_11C controller and pending-selection field with 0x00466350, so the two are update/confirm halves of one window, but nothing names that window.

name: Battle_Ui_NotifyMemberModelChanged
signature: void Battle_Ui_NotifyMemberModelChanged(PartyWindow* self, PartyModel* model, u32 member)
summary: Clears the f_79 byte on every unit model in the four battle unit lists, then sends a {memberId, model} message through the party window's virtual +0x60 and stores the reply at window+4.
evidence: Both callers (Battle_PlayPartyMemberSe, Battle_UnitModel_AdvanceAnimSequence) change which member a model shows; body clears f_79 over the four +0x428C lists and dispatches through self->childWidget vtable +0x60.

name: Battle_RollStatusProc
signature: u32 Battle_RollStatusProc(void* actor, void* target, int statusId)
summary: Rolls 1..100 on the battle RNG and compares against a game-setting threshold selected by the actor value; returns 1 when the roll passes, gated on target alive and a global flag.
evidence: Uses named func_001CA474(&battle rng,1,100) and Game_GetDataManager settings record fields f_144/f_145/f_146; caller Battle_ApplyDamageClamp and maybe_Battle_RollActionStatusChance support a status-proc reading.

name: Battle_MessageRow_RollVariance
summary: Rolls a symmetric battle-RNG value in [-f_14, f_14] and returns it with the battle-work message-row base at +0x4238; all five callers are battle message-row builders.
evidence: Caller set is entirely battle message-row code (Battle_MessageRow_BuildLayout, Text_Row_MeasureIconRowWidth, Battle_Row_UpdateFromActorSlot); +0x14 used as symmetric range around zero.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_BuildSlotIds
summary: Large gimmick slot-setup routine; only the std_ConstructArray of eight 4-byte entries is recoverable, the rest of the 1408-byte body is unreachable in the decompilation.
evidence: Ghidra ends the body at std_ConstructArray; callers are gimmick slot/config functions but the stores that would show what ids are built were lost.

name: Battle_Effect_SpawnFocusEffect
summary: Selects and spawns one of the two battle focus-point effects for the model based on the 0..1 ratio from vtable getters +0x90/+0x94, gated by bits 0x10/0x20 at +0xF22.
evidence: Callee pair are the named FocusPoint effect spawners; callers Battle_Ui_StartBalloonForMember/All put it in the battle UI path; ratio threshold 0.5.

name: Field2D_Object_ApplyAttribute
signature: void Field2D_Object_ApplyAttribute(u32 ignored, u32 id, u32 arg3, u32 manager)
summary: Resolves the 2D scene object with the given id through the shared scene-sprite context and applies attribute constant 0xC41 to its model part at +0x3C.
evidence: Id lookup func_002E5A34, Gfx_GetSceneSpriteContext and model-part attribute call with literal 0xC41 are clear; callers Field2D_Actor_StepMoveTargets / Field2D_Scene_RenderObjects fix the 2D object subsystem.

name: Node_ComputeAttachedTransform
signature: void Node_ComputeAttachedTransform(float* out, void* node, float* params)
summary: Computes the transform of an object attached to a scene node: copies the parameter point, rotates the node basis, probes along the result with Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesAlongLine and writes the entry-relative position plus base translation.
evidence: Copy/rotate/cast/store sequence fully visible; callees Math_TransformOffsetPoint and Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesAlongLine are named; callers Field_SpinAction_Update and maybe_Battle_UpdateSkullRunAnchor.

name: Field_ModelObj_ReleaseSprite
summary: Field model-object teardown: runs the base slot and passes the sprite instance handle f_50 to the scene helper 0x002E7B58, counterpart of Field_ModelObj_CreateSprite.
evidence: Counterpart creator 0x004FABC0 is confidently named Field_ModelObj_CreateSprite and its three callers are exactly the same three that call this one; f_50 is the sprite handle it stores.

name: maybe_Field_QueryFourPoints
signature: void maybe_Field_QueryFourPoints(void* owner, int* origin, int* offsets, u8* results, u8* hitBytes)
summary: Runs four one-unit scene probes at relative offsets, storing a boolean per probe and optionally the first byte of each hit object; the write-back half is damaged (unaff_r6).
evidence: Loop of four over func_002E7288 with owner layer f_AC / params f_9C and f_5C is literal, but the optional hit-byte pointer is the lost register unaff_r6; damaged decompilation rule keeps maybe_.

name: maybe_Svc_AcClient_AcquireSessionLock
summary: Tiny AC-client guard: if Svc_AcClient_CheckSession reports an open session it calls Svc_AcClient_Close, then locks the monitor; the monitor/refcount teardown tail is Ghidra over-running into the next entry.
evidence: 24-byte wrapper (push {r4,lr}; bl Svc_AcClient_CheckSession; cmp; blne Svc_AcClient_Close; pop) and 0x00501D14 is a separate entry owning the monitor/refcount code.

name: maybe_Text_BuildGlyphQuadsThumb
signature: void maybe_Text_BuildGlyphQuadsThumb(int self, u32 count, float * chars, float * layout)
summary: Thumb fragment of the glyph-quad builder: the same per-character transform/UV loop as Text_BuildGlyphQuads (0x0055B984), which appears both as its caller and as its callee, so this is a mid-function split symbol rather than a separate routine.
evidence: Callee list contains 0x0055B984 Text_BuildGlyphQuads, which is also the only caller; body damaged (unaff_r6/unaff_r7, BADSPACEBASE).

name: maybe_Effect_SpawnOrientedInstance
summary: No dossier or readable file available; keep the current uncertain name.
evidence: No dossier (no readable file); nothing to confirm or correct.

name: maybe_BattleScene_CountVisibleUnits
summary: Counts the visible entries of the battle unit list at battle+0x4254 through Container_List_CountVisible; the remainder of the body is lost to a bad-instruction truncation.
evidence: Only recoverable work is Container_List_CountVisible on the first battle unit list (+0x4254, per FACTS) and the body ends in halt_baddata.

name: maybe_Ui_Part_SetupFromActorSprite
summary: Mirrors an actor's two sprite objects into a UI part: marks both sprite objects dirty, initialises the part's two sub-objects at +8 and +0x2E from the actor, then stores the outfit/attachment bytes at +6, +7, +0x19, +0x1A and +0x1B, choosing between two byte patterns from the sprite sub-offset.
evidence: Callees in this range carry names from other subsystems (Craft_BuildIngredientOwnershipList, Ui_SmithMenu_OpenPage, Ui_SmithMenu_GetRecipeAttrBitmask), so they cannot be used to fix the name; no callers.

name: maybe_HandleRecord_GetNameLength
summary: Returns the length of the wide name at rec+8 when the record's four leading id bytes are all set (none is 0xFF), and 0 otherwise; a validity-gated name-length getter, not an assert.
evidence: 0x00100B74 is wcslen (Thumb loop counting u16 until 0, then bx lr), so the tail call returns a value instead of aborting; the four 0xFF comparisons are a 'record is initialised' test.

name: maybe_Monster_CountDistinctRecordedKinds
summary: Builds a 65-word bitmask over the record field +0x22 of every id present in owner+0x3AE4 (also setting the bits of the three related ids found through the table at 0x007273A4), popcounts it and returns that number clamped to 999.
evidence: Callers (Ui_ShopItemInfo_FillStats, Menu_StatusScreen_InitFaceAndCommands) do not fit a monster walk, and the record accessor 0x0063DCA4 has no readable file, so neither the table identity nor the meaning of field +0x22 is proven.

name: maybe_Monster_SumRecordedCounts
summary: Walks 0x413 ids, and for each record with non-zero +0x22 adds the per-id counter at owner+0x3AE4+id*4, clamping the total to 99,999.
evidence: Loop bound 0x413 and accessor 0x0063DCA4 unchanged; callers Ui_ShopItemInfo_FillStats and Menu_StatusScreen_InitFaceAndCommands still do not fit a monster walk, so the table identity stays open.

name: maybe_Ui_BagCategory_FilterAvailable
signature: void maybe_Ui_BagCategory_FilterAvailable(u32* out, BagListOwner* owner, int category)
summary: Builds a 7-byte list from the owner, keeps only bytes whose membership test 0x003AA574 succeeds, and packs them into the 0xFF-prefilled output.
evidence: Membership test 0x003AA574 is still SkillPanel_CanUnlockSkill and filler 0x00646C4C still maybe_Ui_Part_BuildAnimSlotList, so the bag-category reading is unconfirmed.

name: maybe_DataTable_IsIndexValidB
summary: When the style byte at plate[0] is below 0x1F, fetches the table header and returns 0 if the sub-index at plate+0x10 exceeds the header limit at +8; otherwise 1.
evidence: Header getter 0x0063F93C is a mid-function label inside 0x0063F6D4, and the four callers are Party_* routines, so the table identity is unresolved.

name: maybe_DataTable_GetEntryB
summary: Resolves the table header, follows its +0xC relative pointer, and returns the 5-byte entry selected by the sub-index at plate+0x10.
evidence: Body returns a pointer into a 5-byte-stride array and writes nothing; header getter is a merged symbol and the +0xC section is unnamed.

name: maybe_Field_CheckGridInteraction
summary: Resolves the grid cell under the player, classifies the four neighbouring direction entries against the map-object tables, and asks the point hit test 0x00651954 to confirm the hit.
evidence: Both callers are interaction attempts and callee 0x00651954 is the point hit test, but both callers are themselves maybe_, so wording stays tentative.

name: maybe_Field2D_Layer_GetField12
summary: Returns byte +0x12 of the layer record at layer->f_04->f_298, compared across 0x38-byte Field2D layer entries.
evidence: Disassembly ldr r0,[r0,#4]; ldr r0,[r0,#0x298]; ldrb r0,[r0,#0x12] is certain, but whether the byte is a layer id, floor index or tag remains ambiguous.

name: maybe_Engine_SubmitFrameEntries
summary: Frame step: pumps the sound voice list, then when global 0x007AE18C is set calls vtable +0x20 on every object in the self->f_54..f_58 array with fixed frame arguments.
evidence: Body is only the sound voice-list pump plus an indirect 8-byte-strided vtable+0x20 loop; no draw-list construction, and the queued object class is unidentified.

name: maybe_Fs_Channel_InitFields
signature: u32 maybe_Fs_Channel_InitFields(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Initialises one transfer channel: stores the source pointer, initialises the completion event, and submits a 0x2000-byte staging buffer with mode 0x11 and handle -2; returns 1.
evidence: Three-field initialiser over the +0xE1xx block (pointer, event, command buffer) returning 1; the Fs_Channel owner and field meanings are still unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Svc_IsFeatureAvailable
summary: No dossier available; name kept as-is.
evidence: No readable file or dossier; nothing to verify.

name: maybe_Ui_BranchTargetFragment
summary: No dossier available; name kept as-is.

name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_UpdateExtentAndTrail
summary: Per-frame update of a scene-node action: mode 1 interpolates the node's extents f_98/f_9C with rounding, mode 2 pushes a trail sample via Gfx_Trail_PushSample, and a sub-mode plays an animation on the scene node.
evidence: Callees Field_SceneNode_PlayAnimation, Gfx_Trail_PushSample, Gfx_Trail_TryConnectCell and Os_GetGameWork; body writes targetActor->f_98/f_9C and pushes trail samples. Class 'Actor_Action_Move' unverified, so kept maybe_.

name: Field_Marker_OnShow
summary: Show handler of a field marker: calls Field_SceneObject_Show and, if the effect flag is set and the activity test passes, spawns effect 0x496 at the node position and stores the handle.
evidence: Calls Field_SceneObject_Show and Effect_CreateScaledInstance with effect id 0x496 at self position +0.3f Y; no direct caller (vtable slot), so class remains inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_ListScreen_Ctor_vt762EF4
summary: Constructor of a list-window-derived screen: runs Ui_ListWindow_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x762EF4, initialises the member pair and constructs eight 0x18-byte child widgets.
evidence: Base ctor Ui_ListWindow_CtorBase, Ui_Object_InitMemberPair, std_ConstructArray with 0x18 stride x8; concrete screen identity unknown.

name: maybe_Ui_TextBuilder_StepLayout
summary: Per-frame driver of a timed text/effect layout: interpolates the text origin over a 0x10-frame window, binds style resources and spawns effects/sounds per part entry.
evidence: Calls maybe_Ui_TextBuilder_SetStyleResource, Ui_SmithMenu_SetParamValue for origin interpolation, and per-part 0x18-byte entries; owning class not fully verified.

name: maybe_Ui_TwoListPanel_Ctor
summary: No dossier available; name kept as-is.
evidence: No readable file or dossier; nothing to verify.

name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_PlayScaledActionAnim
summary: Fetches the action animation id and model scale, chooses an animation name by scale flag, and plays it on the owner actor.
evidence: Calls Field_NpcGetActionAnimId and Field_Actor_GetMoveSpeedAndFlag, then invokes a vtable slot with one of two name pointers; action state context unverified.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_DeletingDtorA
summary: Deleting destructor for a message-window variant: installs the primary vtable and secondary table at +0x258, releases the embedded handle at +0x2F4, runs the 2D effect-node destructor and frees the block.
evidence: Stores g_uiMessageWindow3DNodeVtable and vtable+0xD4, calls Field_HandleRelease/Pack_Handle_Dtor on the embedded handle, then Actor2D_EffectNode_DeletingDtor and operator delete; no callers and no strings to pin the concrete window class.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_DtorDeleteB
summary: Deleting destructor: calls the class destructor 0x0028EFB4 (Actor2D_EffectNode_DeletingDtor) then operator delete 0x0010F6CC.
evidence: Only two calls (0x0028EFB4 then 0x0010F6CC); the vtable 0x0076A744 slots are Gfx-node methods, so the Field_Actor label is unverified and the concrete class is unknown.
